title: Bizmates M&As Online International Exchange Education Firm With The World for 216 Million Yen (Cash + Stock Swap) | Aggressive M&A Strategy Toward 10 Billion Yen Revenue Goal｜モリタマナヴ / M&Aニュース解説
Bizmates, Inc. agreed to acquire 90.70% stake in With The World from Shunta Igarashi for approximately ¥200 million.
